Capability controls: query peer/import/export support, host pointer import support, copy engine availability, memory type indexes, alignment requirements, maximum allocation size, and timeout/fence capabilities before any payload test.

Payload controls: deterministic byte patterns, size classes such as 1 MiB, 64 MiB, 256 MiB, 1 GiB, and a near-budget class, source/destination identifiers, checksum before and after, repeat count, and failure isolation.

Compute controls: fixed seed, fixed batch/sequence, fixed precision, deterministic reduction order, disabled nondeterministic autotuning where supported by worker configuration only, and parity artifact hashes; do not widen the existing fixed tolerance.

Lease/admission controls: one physical device per worker initially, atomic lease acquisition, refusal on busy, per-device byte budget, high-water mark, and durable ledger entries compatible with PyRe controller patterns.
Transport separation controls: each test must label itself as transport-only, capacity-only, or arithmetic-parity; results must not be mixed into a single pass/fail claim.
